project.purpose: Own observer-relative mediation and optional Studio production that binds source-owned reality into editable medium-specific expression without creating a second truth authority.

nodes.label: MediaProjection
nodes.responsibility: Define bounded observer-facing representation while source owners retain truth/currentness.
acceptance: RichPerception Pearson coupling requires finite samples and a finite result; its canonical JSON digest rejects NaN/Infinity before recording source identity.

nodes.label: ClaimBinding
nodes.responsibility: Bind allowed expression to exact source revision/claim scope.
acceptance: Later source change does not silently float historical expression.

nodes.label: ProductionState
nodes.responsibility: Own editable creative production state only when actual authoring/rendering work is required.
acceptance: Multiple valid productions do not imply a unique current one.

nodes.label: RenderQC
nodes.responsibility: Produce render/mechanical/factual evidence for exact selected outputs.
acceptance: Mechanical/factual pass is distinguishable from craft/human-response claims.
Media owner preflight rejects a different pinned @remotion/cli version from remotion before render verification.

nodes.label: OutputIdentity
nodes.responsibility: Bind exact selected bytes/outputs to appropriate durable byte authority and provenance.
acceptance: Output identity remains stable independently of publication.

slices.objective: Pressure-test Media-owner projection paths that do not require Studio Production, preserving Studio as optional lowering.
acceptance: At least one non-Studio observer projection is produced/verified without creating unnecessary Production state.
slices.nextAction: Use an existing status/tool-result representation as the first bounded case.

slices.objective: Register the real fishing-fable long-form Writing consumer using the existing Studio Production/Claims and reject unsupported source-verbatim, MSR, carrier-identity and reader-quality promotions.
acceptance: Exactly one owner-native Production with claims and source binding records the reconstructed source as non-verbatim.
The existing Media model validator accepts the production; a checksum consumer rejects drift from exact output bytes.
No mechanical PASS is presented as original-chat equivalence or independent reader acceptance.
For outputs that opt into sourceCarrier, the native owner rejects undeclared files, syntactically valid but incorrect digests, and missing digest witnesses.
For repository=ordivon Claim bindings, the native owner requires exact historical commit/blob presence; do not convert local Git presence into remote reachability.
blockers: Original chat text not present as independent machine-verified bytes.
Independent reader evaluation not yet performed.
slices.nextAction: Mechanical SourceCarrier/Git proofs passed in the current candidate; request independent writing/reader falsification and future source-revision accessibility after merge; do not promote narrative meaning from machine PASS.

gaps: Cross-medium ArtifactObservation integration can be evaluated after Artifact ProducerRef is proven.

review.notes: Initial project-native LEGO planning projection. It does not replace owner-native architecture or evidence.
